title: Prepositions of place · there is / there are

units.title: Prepositions of place
units.rule: Joy predloglari narsa qayerdaligini koʻrsatadi: *in* (ichida), *on* (ustida), *under* (tagida), *behind* (orqasida), *next to* (yonida), *in front of* (oldida), *between* (oʻrtasida), *near* (yaqinida). *The cat is on the chair.* — Mushuk stulning ustida. *The bag is under the table.* — Sumka stolning tagida. Predlog otdan oldin keladi: *in the box*, *on the table*, *next to the door*.
examples: The book is on the table.
The bag is in the box.
The bank is next to the shop.
The car is in front of the house.

text.title: Where is Tom?
text.en:
Dilnoza: Where is Tom?
Bekzod: He isn't in the kitchen.
Dilnoza: Is he under the table?
Bekzod: No, he isn't. Look! He is on the chair, behind the door.
Dilnoza: And where is my bag?
Bekzod: It is next to the window, between the chair and the table.
Dilnoza: My phone is in the bag. Good. Tom, come here!

order.a: The book is on the table.
The phone is in the bag.
The bank is next to the shop.

text.q: The bag is next to the ___.

units.title: there is / there are
units.rule: *There is* — bitta narsa bor, *there are* — koʻp narsa bor: *There is a book on the table.* — Stolda kitob bor. *There are two cats in the garden.* — Bogʻda ikkita mushuk bor. Qisqa shakli: *There's a book*. Inkor: *There isn't a shop here.* — Bu yerda doʻkon yoʻq. *There aren't big shops in Usmat.* Savol: *Is there a bank near here? — Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.* *Are there two beds in the room? — Yes, there are.*
examples: There is a book on the table.
There are two cats in the garden.
There is a park in Usmat.
There isn't a bank near here.
Is there a shop in the street?
Are there three chairs in the room? Yes, there are.

text.title: Our house
text.en: Our house is in Usmat. There are five rooms. There is a big kitchen. There is a fridge in the kitchen. There are two bedrooms. In my bedroom there is a bed, a table and a lamp. There isn't a computer in my room. There is a garden behind the house. There isn't a dog, but there is a cat.

choice.q: There ___ a cat in the garden.
There ___ three books on the table.
There ___ a dog in the house. (inkor)
Are there two chairs? — Yes, there ___.
There ___ two bedrooms in our house.

order.a: There is a park in Usmat.
There are two cats in the garden.

text.q: There are five rooms in the house.
There is a computer in the bedroom.
There is a ___ in the kitchen.
There is a ___ behind the house.

fill.q: There ___ a lamp on the table.
There ___ two cats in the garden.

shadowing.en: The book is on the table.
There is a park in Usmat.
There are two cats in the garden.
The bank is next to the shop.
There isn't a dog in the house.
